xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4282: First-run 'Get set up' checklist on Home; pan install/doctor warn instead of failing on optional tools

plan.title: First-run 'Get set up' checklist on Home; pan install/doctor warn instead of failing on optional tools
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: A fresh Mac cannot finish `pan install` without Docker running and ast-grep present, and tmux is marked required by install, doctor and the dashboard catalog even though Herdr is the default backend. Neither doctor nor the dashboard checks whether Claude or gh is logged in, and Home has no friendly first-run checklist; the only surface is an alarming banner that appears when a required tool is missing.
narratives.Proposal: Add memoized first-run probes (Claude login, gh auth status, host backend) in src/lib/first-run-checks.ts; make tmux/Herdr required flags follow the host backend; extend GET /api/prerequisites with auth, backend and memory (from the existing system-health snapshot) and ?refresh=1; render a dismissible, never-blocking 'Get set up' card on both Homes (banner hidden on Home); move the pan install gate and the doctor core/login rows into small pure modules that forgive Docker, ast-grep and (under Herdr) tmux with warnings; update quickstart, CLI and terminal-backend docs. Full detail in .pan/drafts/pan-4282.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Changing memory governor thresholds (PAN-4267)
- Moving ad-hoc/plain terminals from tmux to Herdr
- Running any install from the dashboard
- The Home composer, No-project deck and UI-mode default (#4280)
- The Add-project dialog and Smart field (#4281)
- An onboarding wizard or sidebar checklist modal
- GitLab, Linear or Jira auth checks
- Removing SetupChecklistBanner from non-Home tabs
- Adding a new HTTP route

autoDecisions.summary: Mount the card independently of #4280: after </header> on Advanced Home and after <TalkItThrough /> on Simple Home (after <HomeComposer> if #4280 has landed).
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue says the card goes under the composer, but the composer is #4280's and not merged; a one-line insert keeps this slice independently shippable and the rebase trivial.

autoDecisions.summary: Claude login counts as a required card row; gh login, Docker, tmux-under-Herdr and memory are informational. A backend (Herdr) row is added to the card.
autoDecisions.rationale: An installed but logged-out Claude cannot start agents, and without a backend row a Mac missing Herdr would see nothing on Home once the banner is hidden there.

autoDecisions.summary: Extract doctor rows into src/cli/commands/doctor-first-run.ts and the install gate into src/cli/commands/install-prereqs.ts instead of growing doctor.ts and adding an allowlist row.
autoDecisions.rationale: doctor.ts is at its 1034-line ceiling; pure modules are testable without importing inquirer/ora and follow the existing doctor-*.ts pattern.

autoDecisions.summary: checkSystemPrerequisites takes an optional { backend } and defaults to hostTerminalBackendName(); required is computed at report time.
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps existing callers working and lets tests pin the backend.

autoDecisions.summary: Report composition lives in a new routes/misc/prerequisites-report.ts with injected deps; memory comes from getSystemHealthSnapshot() and is null unless fresh.
autoDecisions.rationale: Resolves the issue's implementation checkpoint (the spawn route uses the same getter) and makes the report shape unit-testable.

autoDecisions.summary: Banner and card share queryKey ['prerequisites']; Re-check writes the refreshed report into the cache with setQueryData.
autoDecisions.rationale: Prevents the two surfaces from disagreeing after a re-check.

autoDecisions.summary: Tests go to src/lib/__tests__/system-prerequisites.test.ts and tests/unit/cli/doctor-first-run.test.ts rather than the paths named in the issue.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's paths do not exist (tests/unit/lib/system-prerequisites.test.ts, tests/unit/cli/doctor.test.ts); the real test file and the new module are the right homes.

metadata.sizeJustification: 24 files across lib, dashboard server, frontend, CLI and docs; each item is a small vertical slice with its own test, and the slices share one report contract so they belong to one issue (the parent PRD already split the program into three issues).

items.title: Add src/lib/first-run-checks.ts with memoized Claude, gh and host-backend probes

narrative.Action: Implement PRD work item A exactly: exports checkClaudeLogin, checkGhLogin, checkHostBackend, resetFirstRunCheckMemo and the three result interfaces. checkGhLogin uses promisify(execFile)('gh',['auth','status'],{timeout:5000}) (ENOENT => installed:false). checkClaudeLogin wraps Effect.runPromise(getClaudeAuthStatus()) with ok = (loggedIn && !expired) || hasAnthropicApiKey. checkHostBackend uses hostTerminalBackendName() and probeHerdrAvailability(); under tmux it trusts options.tmuxFound. A 60 s promise memo per check, bypassed by {force:true}, entry deleted on rejection. No execSync. Tests per PRD item A, fake timers only around Date.now with execFile mocked.

items.title: Given execFile for `gh auth status` resolves, when checkGhLogin() runs, then it returns { installed: true, ok: true }; a non-zero exit returns { installed: true, ok: false }; an ENOENT error returns { installed: false, ok: false }
Given a gh probe ran less than 60 s ago, when checkGhLogin() is called again, then execFile is not invoked a second time; after the clock advances 60 001 ms or with { force: true } it probes again
Given getClaudeAuthStatus reports loggedIn:true, expired:false, when checkClaudeLogin() runs, then it returns ok:true; expired without ANTHROPIC_API_KEY returns ok:false; API key only returns ok:true
Given the host backend is herdr, when checkHostBackend() runs, then available and reason are copied from probeHerdrAvailability()
Compute tmux/Herdr required flags from the host backend in system-prerequisites.ts

narrative.Action: Implement PRD work item B (decisions D2, D3): add the herdr catalog entry (install hint `pan install`, versionArgs ['--version']), update the tmux purpose, add exported requiredFor(definition, backend), and an optional { backend } options argument to checkSystemPrerequisite and checkSystemPrerequisites that defaults to await hostTerminalBackendName(). allRequiredFound uses the computed flag. Update the two existing tests that rely on tmux being required to pass { backend: 'tmux' }; add the herdr/tmux cases from the PRD. If importing select.js statically creates a load cycle, import it lazily inside the function.

narrative.Action: Implement PRD work item C (decisions D4, D5, D6). New module exports buildPrerequisitesReport({ refresh }, deps?) with injectable checkPrerequisites, checkClaudeLogin, checkGhLogin, checkHostBackend and getHealth (default: dynamic import of getSystemHealthSnapshot from services/system-health-service.js). memory = { availableGb, warnGb, low } rounded to one decimal from summary.availableMemoryBytes and thresholds.memoryAvailableWarningBytes; null when freshness.status !== 'fresh' or the getter throws. meta.ts handler becomes Effect.gen reading ?refresh=1 with `new URL(request.url, 'http://localhost')` (same as meta.ts /api/metrics/tasks). No new route, so no no-loss-matrix row.

Advanced copy is ADVANCED_SETUP_STRINGS in the card file. Export CopyableCommand and installHintFor from SetupChecklistBanner.tsx and reuse them (do not duplicate). pan install gate warns instead of failing on Docker, ast-grep and (under Herdr) tmux

narrative.Action: Implement PRD work item G (decision D14). New pure module install-prereqs.ts exports PrereqResult, forgivenPrereqNames(backend) and evaluatePrereqGate(results, backend, platform?) -> { allPassed, warnings }. install.ts imports PrereqResult from it, checkPrerequisites(herdr, backend) spreads evaluatePrereqGate, installCommand awaits hostTerminalBackendName() (import from ../../lib/terminal-backends/select.js), and printPrereqStatus prints a yellow ⚠ for forgiven failures plus each warning line in yellow. Later install steps already tolerate Docker down (Step 3 try/catch warn, Step 6 file writes only); do not change them.
